whoItsFor: Developers and learners who want to understand AI engineering by building it themselves, from model internals through retrieval pipelines to agent runtimes. It suits people comfortable with Python, TypeScript, or Rust who prefer hands-on code and evaluation over using black-box tools.
useCases: Learn model internals, such as gradient descent and optimizers, by implementing them in code
Build and evaluate retrieval (RAG) pipelines with ranking metrics and regression checks
Build agent runtimes, including trace debugging and tool-call approval firewalls
